definitions.explanation: An official day off designated by the government.
A day on which a festival or celebration is held.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}は{祭日|さいじつ}なので{会社|かいしゃ}は{休|やす}みだ。
examples.english: Tomorrow is a national holiday, so the company is closed.

examples.japanese: {日曜|にちよう}{祭日|さいじつ}は{営業|えいぎょう}していません。
examples.english: We are closed on Sundays and holidays.

examples.japanese: {祭日|さいじつ}には{旗|はた}を{掲|かか}げる{家|いえ}もある。
examples.english: Some households display flags on national holidays.

notes:
RELATED TERMS:
・{祝日|しゅくじつ} - national holiday (more common official term)
・{休日|きゅうじつ} - holiday, day off
・{平日|へいじつ} - weekday

NOTE: {祝日|しゅくじつ} is the more commonly used term for national holidays in modern Japanese.
